title: Subthalamic and thalamic local field potentials during DBS in cervical dystonia (Wiest et al. 2022; derivative, DC-removed release at 4096 Hz)
description: Local field potential recordings from externalised octopolar DBS leads in 7 patients (12 hemispheres) with isolated idiopathic cervical dystonia, spanning the subthalamic nucleus, rostral zona incerta and ventrolateral thalamus. Recordings were made 4-7 days after surgery, off medication, during DBS ramps and single-pulse stimulation, with scalp EEG, neck EMG and accelerometers in some patients. This derivative BIDS release (4096 Hz, BrainVision format) supports analysis of stimulation-induced power suppression, evoked resonant neural activity and finely tuned gamma.
methods_description: Recordings used a TMSi Saga amplifier at 4096 Hz with Boston Scientific Vercise Standard leads, exported via Spike2 to MATLAB and repackaged to BrainVision float32. Tasks comprised continuous 130 Hz monopolar DBS with stepwise intensity increases, and single-pulse stimulation applied to each of 8 contact levels. Released signals had undocumented DC removal.
